{{notice|This quest can only be completed once per [[account]] every [[Wintersday]]}}
==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Acquire 99 [[Candy Cane Shard]]s by participating in [[Wintersday]] activities.
* See [[Brrrnadette]] for your reward. 

===Reward===
* [[Frozen Accessory Token]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Brrrnadette
:''"Sorry, I'm just a little blue. It's the one time of the year that I get out of the [[Secret Lair of the Snowmen|lair]], and I'm stuck gathering '''candy cane shards'''. I wanted to be the one who gave out the hats. Wintersday should be about excitement and people get more excited about festive headwear than almost anything. Plus, I have to compete with [[Krunch|some grentch]] who's giving away tokens for only 100 shards.

:''Well, at least you get to join in the games. Help [[Dwayna]]'s side beat back [[Grenth|the cold]] and I'll give you a token for bringing me 99 shards! I'll show that grentch..."
{{offer dialogue
|accept = Cheer up, it's Wintersday! I'll be back with that candy before you can say, "[[Rudi]]'s red nose."
|decline = You are bumming me out.
|ask = No, I'm not the one with the hats; I'm the one collecting '''candy cane shards'''. Do [[Snowman|we]] all look alike to you?}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Brrrnadette
:''"That trade was in your favor, 'cause now that we're done, I've got 99 shards, but hats? Not a one.

:''Except my top hat, but you can't have it. Alright, I'm done moping. Take that token and go see [[Brrrtie]]. And tell him next year we're switching jobs!"''

== Notes ==
* Despite the quest summary only mentioning that the player must ''acquire'' 99 candy cane shards, they actually have to be handed over to Brrrnadette to receive the reward.
* The [[Quest Log]] displays ''"Brrrnadette (Lion's Arch)"'' even if your character acquired this quest in Kamadan.
{{bug|
* Unlike other [[quest]]s, this quest is not indicated with a ''"(Completed)"'' beside the quest name in the Quest Log after the objective is completed.
* You cannot accept the quest reward while your [[character]]'s [[inventory]] is full and the inventory holds another Frozen Accessory Token in it, even though Frozen Accessory Tokens are [[Item stacking|stackable]].}}

== Trivia ==
* [[w:The Polar Express|The Polar Express]] is a book about a Christmas story.
* Part of the reward dialogue (''"I've got 99 shards, but hats? Not a one."'') is similar to the lyrics from the [[w:99 Problems|99 Problems]] song by Jay-Z (which is based on the lyrics of the [[w:Home Invasion (album)|99 Problems]] song by Ice-T): ''"I've got 99 problems but a bitch ain't one."''
* This quest was introduced in [[Wintersday 2012]].
